segments.name: Healthcare services
segments.description: Provides medical services including orthopedic, trauma, sports medicine, general practice and other specialist care to patients in Singapore.
segments.evidence: Our Group is a healthcare group primarily involved in the provision of a comprehensive range of health services including but not limited to orthopedic treatments and surgeries, trauma and sports medicine services (both surgical and non-surgical), physiotherapy services, general practices, health screening, mental health, woman's health and neurological treatments.

revenueModel.text: Patients, their employers or insurers pay the Group fees for medical services rendered, based on an internal itemized fee scale referenced to Ministry of Health benchmarks.
revenueModel.evidence: Our fees are paid for either by the patient, or by the patient's employer or insurer in the case of a qualifying claim which qualification depends on the terms of employment or insurance coverage of such patient.

changes.text: In 2025, the Group acquired Bethesda Medical, adding six general practice clinics in Singapore.
changes.evidence: The acquisition of Bethesda Medical was completed on April 30, 2025.
